purpose: Final paired sensitivity evaluation after model lock, never development labels or hyperparameter selection
selection_before_evaluation: Frozen development candidates: ESN, same-data MLP/RNN, original or optimized VMC, optimized admittance/impedance, plus the best pre-existing RL candidate if time permits. Select on development task/strict, safety, completion/progress and disclosed Pareto metrics before any heldout outcome.
interpretation: Four paired predeclared perturbation conditions in one fixed geometry, not random population samples or universal generalization. h1/h4 retain 1s separation after human retraction; all ball-human windows remain distinct. Contact exposure is measured, never forced for favorable rankings.
